 For the State : Mr. S.K. Tiwari, A.P.P.
 -----
 Oral Order
 05 / Dated : 22.03.2023
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S.
Case No. 61 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(B), 66(C), 66(D) of the I.T. Act.

entities.text:
Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S.
Case No. 61 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that out of two mobiles, which were recovered by the police, one was of the petitioner and with regard to other mobile, it is submitted that the same was planted by the police.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner is professional and he has two criminal antecedent of similar nature.
Para 41 of the case diary reveals that suspicion has been created that four Sim Cards were recovered from the possession of the petitioner.
Considering the gravity of offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly,
his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that out of two mobiles, which were recovered by the police, one was of the petitioner and with regard to other mobile, it is submitted that the same was planted by the police.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner is professional and he has two criminal antecedent of similar nature.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Para 41 of the case diary reveals that suspicion has been created that four Sim Cards were recovered from the possession of the petitioner.
Considering the gravity of offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly,
his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
1 However, the trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as expeditiously as possible, preferably within six months.
The petitioner will be at liberty to renew his prayer for bail after six months of framing of charge.
